ground_truth: The `detachHSG` function fails to remove Safe owners who no longer wear the required hat. An attacker can exploit this by creating many new signers before detachment, thereby gaining majority control of the Safe's owners and its assets once the HSG guard is removed.

The `checkTransaction` function is vulnerable to reentrancy. An attacker can use a nested `delegatecall` to overwrite the stored Safe state (owners, threshold) mid-execution, causing the post-transaction security check to pass and allowing them to bypass restrictions on altering the Safe's configuration.
